d: The Commercial Executive is part of the Group's Commercial Intelligence function and is responsible for preparing proposals, pricing models, feasibility studies, and commercial analyses across Flowciti's businesses, including parking, valet, car park management, and mobility services. The role turns client requirements and operational inputs into accurate, competitive, and profitable commercial offers, delivered within the Group's proposal turnaround standards.

The position works closely with Business Development, Operations, Central Planning, Finance, Marketing, and external cost consultants. The role makes structured, responsible use of AI and digital tools to speed up proposal production, strengthen analysis, and build the Group's commercial knowledge base.
Prepare commercial proposals, quotations, and tender submissions in line with client requirements and the Group's proposal process.
Coordinate with Operations, Central Planning, technical teams, and external cost consultants to gather the inputs required for each proposal.
Once trained, run standard proposals day to day, with the Head of Commercial & Service Development leading, reviewing, and signing off every bid.
Manage the timeline for assigned bids, tracking inputs and escalating delays so that standard proposals are delivered within the five-working-day target.
Ensure proposals pass the quality and completeness review before release, with no missing scope, inconsistent pricing, or unapproved commitments.
Maintain proposal templates, pricing schedules, and supporting documentation.
Support the review and approval process for commercial submissions.
Prepare commercial feasibility studies for new sites and opportunities, including parking, valet, and mobility projects.
Build financial models covering demand and revenue drivers (e.g. occupancy, tariffs, dwell time, transaction volumes), capital and operating costs, payback, NPV, and IRR.
Run base, downside, and upside cases with sensitivity analysis, and present the results clearly to management.
Establish the client's current baseline (existing revenues, costs, and performance) before building a proposal or feasibility case.
Apply the Group's feasibility framework and margin guardrails, flagging opportunities that fall below the minimum margin threshold.
Source and document every key assumption, clearly separating verified data from estimates.
Coordinate site surveys and site visits to capture operational and physical data.
Contribute to post-award reviews comparing feasibility assumptions with actual performance.
Assist in the development of pricing structures and commercial models for new and existing services.
Conduct cost analysis and profitability assessments to support pricing decisions.
Prepare financial summaries and commercial evaluations for business opportunities.
Monitor market pricing trends and competitor activities.
Support management in identifying opportunities to improve profitability and revenue generation.
Use AI tools (such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or ChatGPT) to draft proposal content, summarise RFPs and tender documents, conduct research, and accelerate analysis.
Build and maintain reusable prompts, templates, and AI-assisted workflows for recurring proposal and feasibility tasks.
Identify repeatable proposal categories suitable for standardisation or automation, and help build and test working prototypes.
Check and validate all AI-generated content and figures for accuracy before use.
Follow the Group's data, confidentiality, and approved-tools policies when using AI and digital tools with client information.
Help build and maintain digital intake forms, the bid tracker, and dashboards (e.g. Microsoft Forms, SharePoint, Power BI).
Assist in developing commercial structures for service offerings and client engagements.
Support contract preparation, review, and administration activities.
Ensure commercial terms and conditions are accurately reflected in proposals and agreements.
Coordinate with Finance and Legal teams on commercial documentation and compliance requirements.
Support the handover of won contracts to Operations, ensuring pricing, commitments, and assumptions are passed on accurately.
Maintain records of contracts, proposals, and commercial agreements.
Support the identification and evaluation of new business opportunities.
Build and maintain market, competitor, and pricing intelligence for the Group's priority markets.
Identify cross-selling opportunities across Flowciti's services.
Assist in preparing business cases, presentations, and commercial reports.
Participate in client meetings, site visits, and commercial discussions when required.
Support relationship-building activities with clients and business partners.
Keep the pipeline and bid tracker accurate, with status, deadlines, next actions, and missing information for each opportunity.
Contribute to the central commercial knowledge library: past proposals, pricing references, commercial models, assumptions, and contracts.
Prepare win/loss reviews and capture lessons learned to improve future proposals.
Prepare periodic reports on pipeline, proposal turnaround, success rates, and commercial performance.
Develop dashboards and management reports to support decision-making.
Ensure commercial information is properly documented, archived, and easy to retrieve.
Support the continuous improvement of commercial processes and proposal management systems.
Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and approval authorities.
Assist in developing standardised commercial documentation and templates.
Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in commercial operations.
Percentage of standard proposals delivered within five working days.
Percentage of proposals passing the quality and completeness review without material rework.
Accuracy of feasibility and pricing assumptions against actual performance.
Completeness and accuracy of the bid tracker and knowledge library.
Number of proposal and feasibility tasks standardised or supported by AI and automation.
Contribution to pipeline growth and win rate.
Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
Certification in financial modelling (e.g. FMVA), Commercial Management, Contract Management, or Project Management is advantageous.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (financial modelling, scenario and sensitivity analysis) is required, along with strong PowerPoint and Word skills.
Working knowledge of Power BI or similar business reporting tools is advantageous.
2–5 years of experience in commercial operations, proposal preparation, feasibility, pricing, business development, or related functions.
Hands-on experience preparing feasibility studies or financial models (revenue, cost, payback, NPV/IRR) is required.
Demonstrable, practical use of AI tools in day-to-day work; candidates should be able to show examples of how they have used AI to improve output or speed.
Experience in tender preparation, contract administration, or bid management is preferred.
Experience in parking, mobility, facilities management, real estate, hospitality, or service contracting is advantageous.
Experience in the GCC market is advantageous.
Strong analytical and numerical skills with attention to detail.
Experience working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

The MEP Associate Director – Project Delivery is responsible for leading, coordinating, and overseeing all Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) activities across multiple projects to ensure delivery on time, within budget, and in compliance with quality, safety, and authority requirements.
The role acts as a technical authority and strategic partner to project directors, consultants, contractors, and authorities.
q: Expert knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, ELV, fire & life safety systems
Proven experience in authority compliance (local codes, utilities, civil defense)
Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills
Commercial awareness and cost control capability
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
12–18+ years of MEP experience in large-scale real estate or infrastructure projects
Minimum 5–7 years in a senior management / leadership role
Professional certifications (CIBSE, PMP, PE, or equivalent) preferred
r: Lead MEP delivery across multiple developments (residential, mixed-use, hospitality, retail).
Ensure MEP works align with approved designs, specifications, authority approvals, and project schedules.
Monitor progress, resolve technical issues, and mitigate risks impacting delivery.
Oversee MEP design development from concept to IFC.
Review and approve MEP designs, value engineering proposals, and technical submissions.
Ensure integration between MEP, architectural, structural, and master planning disciplines.
Monitor MEP construction activities on site for quality, safety, and compliance.
Lead resolution of site technical issues, clashes, and non-conformances.
Review method statements, shop drawings, material submittals, and mock-ups.
Oversee testing, commissioning, and snagging of all MEP systems.
Ensure systems meet performance criteria and authority requirements.
Support smooth handover to FM/operations teams, including O&M manuals and as-built drawings.
Act as main MEP point of contact with:
Internal development, design, and FM teams
Support authority submissions, inspections, and approvals.
Support cost control by reviewing variations, claims, and change orders related to MEP.
Drive value engineering initiatives without compromising quality or performance.
Identify and mitigate technical and delivery risks early.
Lead and mentor MEP managers, engineers, and site teams.
Establish MEP standards, best practices, and lessons learned across projects.
Provide regular reporting on MEP progress, risks, and performance to senior management.

d: Cohorts: January & June (Yearly) | Function: Multiple, apply once and tell us where you want to build

Tamara is Saudi Arabia's first FinTech unicorn, on a mission to help people own their dreams by building the most customer-centric financial super app in the world. There's no playbook for that; our Tamarians are writing it as we go, and we believe potential should be stretched early.

The Internship Program is built for students who don't want to sit on the sidelines. Our internships welcome undergraduate and postgraduate students alike (Master's, MBA, or PhD), and if you're hungry to apply what you've learned in a fast-moving, high-performance environment, this is where you begin. We treat our interns and co-ops as future builders, because in many ways, they already are.

This year, we're keeping things simple: one application gets you into the running for any area you're interested in. Just share a bit about yourself, highlight what you're great at, and tell us which teams get you excited. We want you to work on what you're passionate about, so we'll look at your interests to match you with a role where you can jump in and start building.

Product: Get hands-on with how a fintech unicorn builds products people actually love. You'll support Product Managers in shaping features used by millions of shoppers, drawing on data and customer insight to explore areas for improvement, conceptualise new products, and dive into a wide range of financial services, from personal banking to brand new fintech solutions.

Engineering: Write code that ships. As part of our engineering team, you'll work alongside senior engineers on live projects, from feature builds to system improvements, gaining mentorship and real production experience from day one.

Design: Help design the experiences behind a product millions of people trust with their money. You'll contribute to real flows and interfaces, working closely with Product and Engineering to build seamless fintech solutions. You will dive directly into uncovering user needs, mapping out core user journeys, and rapidly iterating through wireframes.
Data: Get hands-on with the numbers behind millions of transactions. You'll support analytics and reporting that help teams understand customers, measure impact, and make better decisions.

Commercial: Our Commercial teams cover two sides of the same goal: Sales, where you'll help find, pitch, and sign new merchant partners, and Account Management, where you'll help look after existing partners and grow those relationships over time.
Marketing: Get hands-on with how a fintech unicorn tells its story. You'll support brand, growth, and campaign work that reaches customers and merchants across the region.

Finance & Accounting: Get inside the financial engine of a unicorn. You'll support month-end close, financial reporting, and audits, learning what it takes to keep a fast-scaling company's numbers accurate and controlled.

Strategy: Work close to the top. You'll contribute to market research, competitor benchmarking, and strategic projects that inform decisions made by Tamara's executive team: real exposure to strategic thinking at the highest level.
Note: The functions listed above aren't an exhaustive list. If you're interested in an area we haven't mentioned here, tell us on your application; we still want to hear from you.
q: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's,MBA or PHD in a relevant field, we welcome applications from both undergraduate and postgraduate students
Passionate about continuous iteration and bringing a creative mindset to solving problems, no matter the function.
Prior Internship, Co-op, or project experience relevant to your area of interest is a plus, but not required; we care more about your curiosity and drive than a packed CV
Good organisational skills: able to prioritise and manage your workload independently
Comfortable with Google Workspace / basic tools of your field; anything more specialised (like coding languages or CRM tools) is a bonus, not a requirement
Curious, driven, and genuinely excited to build, not just observe
A self-starter who takes initiative rather than waiting for instructions
Resilient and adaptable, thriving in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment
A collaborative team player who leads with empathy and respect
Eager to learn and grow, with the energy to match a high-performance environment
Our teams are made up of innovators, problem-solvers, and learners. We thrive on curiosity and collaboration. If this sounds like you: curious, driven, and ready to build, we'd love to meet you.
Apply now and join the next generation of Builders.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. To learn more about how we protect your privacy, please visit our Candidate Privacy Notice.
